doc.projectIntro: This quote covers an Openserve fibre link and a 3CX VoIP line for Nova Nexus Group, provided on a 24-month term and billed monthly, together with the once-off fibre installation. The monthly total below is based on the 100Mbps service; a 200Mbps option is shown should you prefer the faster link. Wi-Fi and 3CX handsets are quoted separately. All prices exclude VAT (15%).

items.detail: Once-off installation and activation of the Openserve fibre link at your premises, including router configuration and handover. The same charge applies whether you take the 100Mbps or 200Mbps service.
100Mbps uncapped fibre connectivity via Openserve, billed monthly.
One 3CX VoIP line, billed monthly. Additional lines can be added at any time at the same rate of R99 per line per month ex VAT.
Faster alternative to the 100Mbps link above, in place of it rather than in addition to it. Choosing 200Mbps brings the monthly total to R 2 988,85 incl VAT; the installation charge is unchanged.
Outgoing calls, billed monthly in arrears. Charged per second, so you pay only for the seconds you actually use.

doc.summaryNote: The monthly total shown is for the 100Mbps service. The 200Mbps link is an alternative at R2,500 per month ex VAT (R 2 988,85 incl VAT per month in total) — just tell us which you'd prefer and the installation charge stays the same. Call charges are additional and billed monthly in arrears at R0.50 per minute, charged per second. Wi-Fi (Ubiquiti UniFi) and 3CX handsets with the required SBC are not included here and will be quoted separately.
terms: This quote is valid for 14 days from the date of issue.
All prices exclude VAT at 15% unless otherwise stated.
The fibre and VoIP service is provided on a 24-month term, billed monthly.
The monthly total is based on the 100Mbps link. The 200Mbps link is available in its place at R2,500 per month ex VAT.
Calls are billed monthly in arrears at R0.50 per minute, charged per second.
Additional 3CX VoIP lines may be added at any time at R99 per line per month ex VAT.
The once-off installation is payable on acceptance, prior to installation.
Service provisioning is subject to Openserve line feasibility at the site.
Wi-Fi equipment and 3CX handsets with the required SBC are excluded and will be quoted separately.
